ἠΰτ: ἠΰτε — like, as, as when; particle, elided (ἠΰτ’)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠετίωνος: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. gen. sg.
ἠτίμησεν: ἀτιμάω — dishonour, slight; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἠτίμησε(ν))
ἡμένη: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’
ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl. (ἤθελον)
ἤκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of the person heard); aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (ἤκουσε(ν))
ἥμενον: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδυίῃ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. sg., epic ἰδυίῃ (= Attic εἰδυίᾳ): ’to you who know’
ἱκέσθην: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 3 dual (strong aor., ἱκέσθην), + acc. of goal: ’the two came to’
ἱλάσκεσθαι: ἱλάσκομαι — appease, propitiate; pres. inf. mid.
ἴτ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἴτ’ = ἴτε)
ἴτην: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 dual (ἴτην = Attic ᾔτην): ’the two went’
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἷκεν: ἵκω — come to, reach; impf./aor. 3 sg. active ἷκεν, ν-movable, unaugmented
ὀλοιῇσι: ὀλοός — destructive, baneful; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς)
ὀλύμπιοι: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, dwelling on Olympus; masc. nom. pl.
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀμίχλη: ὀμίχλη — mist, fog; fem. nom. sg.
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀρεγνύς: ὀρέγνυμι — stretch out, reach out; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ὀτρηρὼ: ὀτρηρός — brisk, active, ready; masc. nom. dual
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὁρόων: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶν)
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφελλεν: ὀφείλω (epic ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; impf. 3 sg. (= ὤφελλεν), + inf., of what should have happened: ’ought to have’
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὑγρὰ: ὑγρός — wet, watery; neut. acc. pl.
ὑπέδεισαν: ὑποδείδω — fear, be afraid of; aor. 3 pl. (ὑπέδεισαν), + acc.
ὑπελύσαο: ὑπολύω — loose from under, set free; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic ὑπελύσω), + gen. of what one is freed from
ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — thundering on high; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὤνησας: ὀνίνημι — benefit, help; aor. 2 sg. act. (ὤνησας)
ὦχ: ὦκα — swiftly, quickly; adv., elided and aspirated (ὦχ’ before a rough breathing)
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν)
ᾠχόμεθ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (ᾠχόμεθ’ = ᾠχόμεθα)
ῥίγιον: ῥίγιον — worse, more grievous; comparative adj. (cf. ῥῖγος ’shudder’), neut. nom. sg., predicate
ἔφησθα: φημί — say, speak; impf. 2 sg., epic -σθα ending (= Attic ἔφης): ’you said, boasted’

__broaden__.ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’)
__broaden__.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν)
__broaden__.τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’)
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’)
__broaden__.οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’whose, of which’ · ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’his own’ (οὗ πατρός ’his own father’)
__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’)
__broaden__.λῆγ: λήγω — cease, leave off (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (λῆγ’ = λῆγε) · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔληγε): ’did cease’ (οὐδ’ Ἀγαμέμνων λῆγ’ ἔριδος ’nor did Agamemnon cease from strife’)
__broaden__.τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’)
__broaden__.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’)
